course_name_en: Numerical Methods and Applications in Engineering

learning_outcomes.text: Modeling Competency: Analyze complex physical problems from different engineering disciplines (Structural, Bio, Signal, Data) and convert them into appropriate mathematical models.
Error Control: Analyze rounding and truncation errors originating from computer arithmetic and scientifically question the reliability and precision of numerical results.

Algorithmic Application and Code Adaptation: Select pre-made MATLAB code snippets presented within the 'Numerical Methods Toolbox' according to the relevant engineering scenario; adapt these codes with correct parameters based on the physical limits of the problem to produce functional solutions.

Process Management: Systematically manage an engineering problem according to a 5-stage solution flow consisting of the steps: "Real Problem -> Mathematical Model -> Numerical Method -> Ready Code Adaptation -> Result/Analysis".
Scientific Interpretation: Interpret the outputs obtained through numerical methods within the context of the problem's area of expertise and produce scientific reports.

Adaptation to Future Tools: Grasp the basic logic of data-driven modeling and Artificial Intelligence-based numerical solutions, gaining a vision to integrate ready-made algorithms into modern engineering problems.
